project_line: Sample Elementary School HVAC Replacement  |  RTU-1 Deck Condition
location: Sample Elementary School, 200 Example Avenue, Anytown, TX 75001, rooftop at RTU-1
prepared_by: Pat Doe, Project Manager, Example Mechanical, LLC
attendance_note: Also on site: the roofing crew.

sections.title: Purpose
items: Walk the roof at RTU-1 with the engineer to review the deck condition found when the curb was opened, and get direction before the new unit is set. The curb set at RTU-1 is on hold; RTU-2 is proceeding.

sections.title: Condition Confirmed
items: The deck along one side of the RTU-1 opening is deteriorated and will not support the new curb as is. The rest of the opening bears on the existing steel.

sections.title: Engineer's Direction
items: The engineer directed adding one support angle along the affected side and replacing the deteriorated deck section with matching metal deck, then rebuilding the roof in kind.
The engineer will issue a written detail within one business day.

sections.title: Approval Routing and Change Order
items: The contractor will price the repair and submit PCO-001 with a full breakdown (description, quantity, unit cost, total, and labor by hours and rates). Work proceeds on the owner's written authorization.

sections.title: Schedule Impact
items: The RTU-1 unit set moves out about one week to allow the repair. RTU-2 is not affected. The contractor will confirm the revised set date once the detail is issued.

sections.title: Interim Weatherproofing
items: Open curbs are covered and weatherproofed at the end of each day until the units are set.

action_items.action: Issue the written detail for the RTU-1 support angle and deck repair
Price the repair and submit PCO-001 with a full breakdown
Authorize the change and direct the work
Confirm the revised RTU-1 set date
